originalTitle: James Webb Space Telescope Uncovers Ancient Galaxy Clusters from the Dawn of Time
originalContent: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have discovered an extraordinary cluster of ancient galaxies that formed less than 600 million years after the Big Bang. The discovery offers unprecedented insight into the early structure of the cosmos and challenges long-held theories regarding the rate of galactic formation. Initial spectroscopic analysis reveals dense star-forming regions with unusually high metallicities for such an early cosmic epoch. Researchers believe these observations will force a major revision of cosmological models, particularly concerning dark matter halos and interstellar gas dynamics.
